rule: The Architect pre-authorizes the complete successor sequence in this file. The Tech Lead may promote a dependency-complete successor Work Order into the executable frontier after completing the predecessor gates, without returning to the Architect for routine authorization. The Architect remains the authority for architecture changes, merges and exceptional escalation.

sequence.target: Cross-application longitudinal economics and developer adoption evidence

gatePolicy.perApplication: AI_EXECUTION_COMPLETE only when every declared material AI execution edge is delegated through Zeck, direct provider egress is absent or provably blocked, the representative corpus remains functional, and every delegated edge correlates to Zeck evidence.
gatePolicy.noDemoUpgrade: Demo status can never upgrade evidence or completeness.
gatePolicy.failureRouting: provider/credential/region/quota/DNS/infrastructure issue -> BLOCKED/NOT-RUN; public-contract issue -> implementation gap; representational/invariant issue -> Architect escalation.
